description: Creators only, on their own Piku account (asks them to connect). Propose a design for the creator's page as a Page draft: any of the look (theme and buttons), bio, link titles, the order of links, widgets, sections and Rates, new links or widgets the creator gave you, groups (a list or a sideways row), up to 2 Rate buttons under the bio, and the Portfolio's numbers and productions. Every field is optional; give only what changes. A style and palette set the look. Nothing on the live page changes: the creator previews the Page draft and applies it, or parts of it, in the page builder. A new design replaces the open one. Returns the draft_id, the changes by part and a preview_url.

add.description: New links or widgets, only from addresses the creator gave you. Links must be https.

url.description: For type link: an https address

value.description: For a widget: its https link, or the WhatsApp number with country code

groups.description: Every group the page will have after the design, in order ([] removes them all; leave it out to keep them). Each group shows where its first item is. Row suits videos and posts; left out, the layout is row when every item is a widget, else list.

items.description: Link and widget ids from get_page, or new:N for an item of add. An item is in one group at most.

layout.description: list: stacked. row: side by side, scrolling sideways

name.description: Shown over the group, like The Conversation

links_order.description: Link and widget ids in the new order; new:0 is the first item of add. Ones left out follow in their order.

look.description: The page's theme, buttons and cover glow. Fonts and custom backgrounds are not available.

button_align.description: Where titles sit on the buttons

button_colour.description: Like #4A2073. get_page lists the named ones

palette.description: 3 colours like #4A2073: the cover glow, left to right. The first is also the button colour unless button_colour is given. From the creator's brand colours or a style's palettes in get_page

theme.description: Background, surfaces, text and accent together. get_page lists them

portfolio.description: The Portfolio tab's numbers strip and productions. A list given replaces that list; one left out stays. Only numbers the creator gave you; never invent reach.

label.description: What it counts, like Instagram followers

by.description: Where it ran or who made it

kicker.description: A word over a featured card, like Show

url.description: Where to watch it; a YouTube link gives the card its still

rate_buttons.description: Every Rate button under the bio after the design ([] removes them). The first is the page's main ask. Only Rates that can be requested.

label.description: The words on the button, like Be a guest

rates_order.description: Rate ids in the new order. Ones left out follow.

sections.description: The tabs shown, in order. The first opens first.

shows.description: How social profile links show, by id from get_page: auto (icon and button), icon (icon only) or button (button only)

style.description: A Page style from get_page: fills the look fields not given (theme, button colour, shape, alignment). Arrange the rest with its recipe, from the creator's own links, Rates and events

titles.description: New titles for links or widgets, by id from get_page

name: design_page
title: Draft a page design
